title: 726. Maximum Length of Repeated Subarray

examples.explanation: The shared window [3,2,1] of length 3 is the longest.
Identical arrays share their full length.
No value overlaps, so nothing repeats.

hints: Let dp[i][j] be the length of the shared suffix ending at nums1[i-1] and nums2[j-1].
Equal endpoints extend the diagonal value by one; mismatches reset to zero.
Track the maximum cell seen during the fill.
